brief: Choose where to keep a near-term reserve using stated access, safety and fee conditions.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Reserve Access"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Mantén reserva al alcance"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Mantenha reserva ao alcance"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Choose where to keep a near-term reserve using stated access, safety and fee conditions.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A near-term reserve needs usable access; compare fictional choices by access timing, stated safety conditions and fees.
instruction.misconception: The highest advertised return is best for emergency money even if access is delayed or principal can fall.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Check access timing, possible losses and withdrawal fees. Match these conditions to the reserve’s purpose.
A matches the stated near-term access requirement.
A price decline can reduce money available for the fixed need.
The withdrawal fee reduces the amount available for the need.
A protection slogan does not establish actual coverage.
A reserve may fail its purpose if money arrives too late.
A alone meets every stated reserve condition.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: A near-term reserve needs usable access; compare fictional choices by access timing, stated safety conditions and fees.

en-US.line: Check access timing, possible losses and withdrawal fees. Match these conditions to the reserve’s purpose.

es-MX.line: Revisa cuándo usar dinero, si monto puede bajar y cargos de acceso. Ajusta condiciones al propósito de reserva.

pt-BR.line: Confira quando usar dinheiro, se valor pode cair e taxas de acesso. Ajuste condições à finalidade da reserva.

en-US.scene: A allows confirmed withdrawal today; B locks withdrawals until next month.

options.label: B because the ad looks better

help: Compare withdrawal timing with when money may be needed.

feedback.met: A matches the stated near-term access requirement.
feedback.not_yet: Compare withdrawal timing with when money may be needed.

es-MX.scene: A permite retiro confirmado hoy; B bloquea hasta próximo mes.
help: Compara plazo de retiro con cuándo puede requerirse dinero.

feedback.met: A cumple requisito indicado de acceso cercano.
feedback.not_yet: Compara plazo de retiro con cuándo puede requerirse dinero.

pt-BR.prompt: Que acesso atende necessidade de amanhã?
pt-BR.scene: A permite saque confirmado hoje; B bloqueia até próximo mês.
help: Compare prazo de saque com quando pode precisar do dinheiro.

feedback.met: A atende requisito dado de acesso próximo.
feedback.not_yet: Compare prazo de saque com quando pode precisar do dinheiro.

en-US.scene: Reserve must cover a bill soon; an investment’s value can fall before then.
help: Check whether the reserve amount can change before use.

feedback.met: A price decline can reduce money available for the fixed need.
feedback.not_yet: Check whether the reserve amount can change before use.

es-MX.scene: Reserva debe cubrir cuenta fija pronto; valor de inversión puede caer antes.
help: Revisa si monto de reserva puede cambiar antes de usarlo.

feedback.met: Caída de precio puede reducir dinero para necesidad fija.
feedback.not_yet: Revisa si monto de reserva puede cambiar antes de usarlo.

pt-BR.scene: Reserva deve cobrir conta fixa logo; valor da aplicação pode cair antes.
help: Confira se valor da reserva pode mudar antes do uso.

feedback.met: Queda de preço pode reduzir dinheiro para necessidade fixa.
feedback.not_yet: Confira se valor da reserva pode mudar antes do uso.

en-US.prompt: How much can be used after this fee?
en-US.scene: Reserve balance: 250; Required withdrawal fee: 10; No other deductions.
help: Subtract the required access fee from the balance.

feedback.met: The withdrawal fee reduces the amount available for the need.
feedback.not_yet: Subtract the required access fee from the balance.

es-MX.scene: Saldo de reserva: 250; Cargo obligatorio de retiro: 10; Sin otros descuentos.
help: Resta cargo requerido de acceso al saldo.

feedback.met: Cargo de retiro reduce monto disponible para necesidad.
feedback.not_yet: Resta cargo requerido de acceso al saldo.

pt-BR.scene: Saldo da reserva: 250; Taxa obrigatória de saque: 10; Sem outros descontos.
help: Subtraia taxa exigida de acesso do saldo.

feedback.met: Taxa de saque reduz valor disponível para necessidade.
feedback.not_yet: Subtraia taxa exigida de acesso do saldo.

en-US.scene: An app says “protected” without identifying where funds sit or the actual coverage.
help: Verify the relevant official conditions for this arrangement.

feedback.met: A protection slogan does not establish actual coverage.
feedback.not_yet: Verify the relevant official conditions for this arrangement.

options.label: No, access must fit the purpose

feedback.met: A reserve may fail its purpose if money arrives too late.
feedback.not_yet: Evaluate access, amount stability and fees together.

es-MX.scene: Opción de mayor rendimiento retrasa retiros más allá del plazo de emergencia indicado.
help: Evalúa acceso, estabilidad del monto y cargos juntos.

feedback.met: Reserva puede fallar si dinero llega demasiado tarde.
feedback.not_yet: Evalúa acceso, estabilidad del monto y cargos juntos.

en-US.prompt: Which option meets these stated requirements?
en-US.scene: Need: prompt access, stable stated balance, no access fee; A meets all, B locks funds, C charges a fee.
help: Match each option to the actual access, safety and cost requirements.

feedback.met: A alone meets every stated reserve condition.
feedback.not_yet: Match each option to the actual access, safety and cost requirements.
